title: Yellowed Grassy British Millet Wrap
description: A keto-friendly Welsh dish featuring millet and wrapped in a ssam-style wrap, with a grassy and velvety texture from the combination of millet, spinach, and feta cheese.
instructions: Rinse the millet in a fine mesh sieve and drain well.
In a medium saucepan, bring the water to a boil and add the millet.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes.
While the millet is cooking, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the spinach to the skillet and cook until wilted, about 3 minutes.
Stir in the feta cheese and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
To assemble the wraps, lay a ssam wrap flat and spoon about 1/2 cup of the cooked millet onto the center of the wrap.
Top the millet with the spinach and feta mixture, and season with salt to taste.
Fold the bottom edge of the wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap into a tight cylinder.
